# Hetzner Storage Box (File Search) MCP connector

Search inside the files of a Hetzner Storage Box from your AI client over SFTP (port 23): full-text index of PDF, Excel, Word and Outlook files, synced in the background. The AnythingMCP connector gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini 10 MCP tools for Hetzner Storage Box (File Search).

## Start without code

No installation and no terminal: AnythingMCP Cloud runs the Hetzner Storage Box (File Search) connector for you, operated by helpcode.ai in Frankfurt, Germany.

1. **Click the button above** and create an account or sign in. The Hetzner Storage Box (File Search) connector opens, ready to install.
2. **Paste the API key or token from your Hetzner Storage Box (File Search) account.** Every click is in the [step-by-step guide](https://anythingmcp.com/marketplace/hetzner-storage-box).
3. **Click Install.** AnythingMCP shows the address of your MCP server.
4. **Add that address to your assistant:** [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-hetzner-storage-box-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-hetzner-storage-box-to-chatgpt) · [Microsoft Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-hetzner-storage-box-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-hetzner-storage-box-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-hetzner-storage-box-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-hetzner-storage-box-to-muse).
5. **Ask your first question**, for example: *Show invoice INV-2026-0789 for customer Solarmade GmbH in the 2026/Invoices folder: I need invoice date and total.*

Prefer help with the setup? [Talk to us](https://anythingmcp.com/contact).

## How it works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  client["Claude · ChatGPT · Copilot · Cursor"]
  amcp["AnythingMCP<br/>roles · audit log · encrypted credentials"]
  api["Hetzner Storage Box (File Search) API"]
  client -- "MCP, OAuth or API key" --> amcp
  amcp -- "HTTPS, user name and password" --> api
```

- **The AI client** speaks MCP (Streamable HTTP) to AnythingMCP and only sees tool names, descriptions and results. It never gets the Hetzner Storage Box (File Search) credentials.
- **AnythingMCP** checks the client's role, builds the call from the tool definition, adds the credentials (user name and password), calls Hetzner Storage Box (File Search), logs the call and returns the result.
- **Hetzner Storage Box (File Search)** sees an ordinary API client with the rights of the account the credentials belong to.

## Run it yourself

AnythingMCP is open source (AGPL-3.0). [Run it with Docker](../../../README.md#run-it-yourself), open **Connectors → Store**, pick **Hetzner Storage Box (File Search)**, then add your MCP server URL to the AI client.
